en.bdb: One Oankar, the primal energy, realized through the grace of divine preceptor
One Oankar, the primal energy, realized through the grace of divine preceptor

verses.gurmukhi: ਏਕੰਕਾਰੁ ਇਕਾਂਗ ਲਿਖਿ ਊੜਾ ਓਅੰਕਾਰੁ ਲਿਖਾਇਆ।
verses.translit_en: eka(n)kaar ikaa(n)g likh uooRaa oa(n)kaar likhaiaa|

en.bdb: That homogenous supreme reality (God) ) first was written as numeral one mulmantr – the credal formula) and then He was inscribed as Ura syllable of Gurmukhi, further pronounced as Oankar.

verses.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਨਾਮ ਕਰਤਾ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਨਿਰਭਉ ਹੁਇ ਨਿਰਵੈਰੁ ਸਦਾਇਆ।
verses.translit_en: satinaam karataa purakh nirabhau hui niravair sadhaiaa|

en.bdb: Then He was called satinamu, the truth by name. Kartapurakh, the creator Lord, nirbhau, the fearless one, and Nirvair, withou rancour.

verses.gurmukhi: ਅਕਾਲ ਮੂਰਤਿ ਪਰਤਖਿ ਹੋਇ ਨਾਉ ਅਜੂਨੀ ਸੈਭੰ ਭਾਇਆ।
verses.translit_en: akaal moorat paratakh hoi naau ajoonee saibha(n) bhaiaa|

en.bdb: Then emerging as the timeless akal murati to caIled as unborn and self-existent.

verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਪਰਸਾਦਿ ਸੁ ਆਦਿ ਸਚੁ ਜੁਗਹ ਜੁਗੰਤਰੁ ਹੋਂਦਾ ਆਇਆ।
verses.translit_en: guraparasaadh su aadh sach jugeh juga(n)tar ho(n)dhaa aaiaa|

en.bdb: Realized through the grace of Guru, the divine preceptor, the current of this primeval truth (God) has continuously moving since before the beginning and throughout the Ages.

verses.gurmukhi: ਹੈਭੀ ਹੋਸੀ ਸਚੁ ਨਾਉ ਸਚੁ ਦਰਸਣ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਦਿਖਾਇਆ।
verses.translit_en: haibhee hosee sach naau sach dharasan satiguroo dhikhaiaa|

en.bdb: He is verily the truth and will continue to be the truth for ever.

verses.gurmukhi: ਸਬਦੁ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਲਿਵਲੀਣੁ ਹੁਇ ਗੁਰੁ ਚੇਲਾ ਪਰਚਾ ਪਰਚਾਇਆ।
verses.translit_en: sabadh surat livaleen hui gur chelaa parachaa parachaiaa|

en.bdb: The true Guru has made available (for me) the glimpse of this truth.

verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰੁ ਚੇਲਾ ਰਹਰਾਸਿ ਕਰਿ ਵੀਹ ਇਕੀਹ ਚੜ੍ਹਾਉ ਚੜ੍ਹਾਇਆ।
verses.translit_en: gur chelaa raharaas kar veeh ikeeh chaRhaau chaRhaiaa|

en.bdb: One who merging his iousness in the Word establishes a relationship of Guru and disciple, that disciple devoting himself to the Guru and progressing from worldliness attunes his consciousness in and with the Lord.
The gurmukhs had the glimpse of imperceptible Lord who is the fruit of delights
